landing.intro: Scan your medicine. Hear how to take am, for your own language. Get reminder when time reach.
landing.verifiedNote: Your hospital dey check every account with their own staff and patient records.
landing.dayIntro: Example of one day for patient. The names no be real people.
landing.morningNote: We go read am out for the patient own language. Choose one:
landing.afternoonSms: Time for Metformin 500 mg. Take 1 tablet after you chop. Reply 1 if you don take am, 2 if you miss am.
landing.afternoonNote: No smartphone, or no data? The reminder go come by SMS or voice call.
landing.eveningSms: Medisent AI: Mama Nkechi never take her {time} Lisinopril. Abeg check on her.
landing.eveningNote: One family member wey the patient choose go get SMS when dose miss.
landing.urgentNote: We dey catch words like chest pain before any AI answer, and hospital staff go hear. The AI no dey diagnose or change dose.
landing.step1: Your hospital go register, come upload their staff and patient list.
landing.step2: You go sign in with your hospital number and your phone. We go check am with the hospital list.
landing.step3: Scan your medicine pack. We go read wetin dey the label give you, come set your reminders.
landing.safety: Medisent AI dey help you follow your prescription. E no fit replace your doctor or pharmacist.
landing.urgentBody: You talk say “chest pain”. We don tell your pharmacist and the person wey dey take care of you.
